eligibility.canonicalForkPolicy: Exclude forks whose upstream appears in discovery pool; record all such exclusions. Independent forks may remain if not a duplicate.
eligibility.backend: Java source and Maven pom.xml in same Git repository; Spring Boot preferred, not mandatory
eligibility.frontend: package.json declaring Vue major 3 and Vite, with real source in same repository
eligibility.workflow: README or corresponding backend/frontend API sources establish at least one business flow; exclude hello-world-only scaffolds
eligibility.license: Recognized open-source SPDX license allowing local inspection and derivative testing; no missing/NOASSERTION/custom noncommercial licenses
eligibility.revision: Pin default-branch commit before random draw
excludedPriorTrials: previous autonomous demo repositories and deterministic fixtures
committed 20261102 compatibility corpus to avoid reusing earlier evaluated samples

prohibitedFilters: Maven profiles or number of roots
rules.sampling: Deterministic name sort of objectively eligible frozen pool, 32 random bytes after freeze, SHA-256(seed + LF + full_name + LF + commit) lexicographic minimum; no redraw for product or environment failure
rules.evaluationOrder: Merge/deduplicate raw search results, sort full repository names, evaluate objective criteria without reading locks or executing compatibility/build probes; aim at least 20 eligible, retain all assessed exclusions.
rules.caveat: Random within a reproducibly frozen search-discovered pool, not a uniform sample of all GitHub repositories

seedGeneration: Python secrets.token_hex(32), once after writing frozen-pool.json
algorithm: SHA256(UTF8(seedHex + LF + full_name + LF + commit)); lexicographic minimum hex score
discoveryNotes: Initial branch queries used the wrong metadata field; those results were discarded and all licensed canonical branches queried correctly before pool freeze. No exclusion used that query error.

Vue catalog resolution fetch unavailable for Starry123229/vben-admin-backend; classification uses its package catalog declarations, Vue source and upstream README explicitly identifying Vue3/Vite. No build probe or lock compatibility filter.
MusaTabitai/weblog excluded before seed for README noncommercial restriction conflicting with detected MIT metadata. No inference about build success.

Eligible source trees contain Java, Maven, Vue source and Vue3/Vite manifest declarations, plus README business workflows and corresponding API/view paths. This is eligibility evidence, not runtime or security acceptance.
